The '''Artful Trickster's heavy blaster''' was a model of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] used around the time of the [[War against Zakuul]]<ref name="TOR" /> and the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:DAR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=weekly|Daily Area: Ruhnuk|Ruhnuk}}</ref>

Artful Trickster's heavy blasters were used by [[Ash'ad]] [[Mandalorian shock trooper]]s during the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian civil war]] of the Third Galactic War,<ref name="TOR:DAR" /> including [[Kaz Denko]].<ref name="TOR:RHPM">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Relic Hunt: Prototype Missiles|Ruhnuk}}</ref> The weapon was also used by the pirate [[Vit'ash Kolk]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="TOR:VK">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Vit'ash Kolk|Hoth}}</ref>

==Appearances==
*[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] {{1st}}
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''

==Behind the scences==
The Artful Trickster's heavy blaster appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" /> It could be obtained in the "Plunderer Pack" available on the [[Cartel Market]] upon the release of the Game Update 4.4, released in [[May]] [[2016]].<ref name="TOR-update">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/532016/game-update-4.4-profit-and-plunder|text=Game Update 4.4: Profit and Plunder}}</ref>
